''O Celtiña'' | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1923|08|23}} (as ''Club Celta''){{cite web |title=Club history|url=https://rccelta.es/en/club/historia/|publisher=RC Celta de Vigo|access-date=15 February 2023}} | stadium = [[Balaídos Stadium|Balaídos]] | coordinates = {{Coord|42|12|42.6|N|8|44|22.9|W|type:landmark_scale:3000_region:ES|display=it}} | capacity = 24,870{{cite web |title=Instalaciones |url=https://rccelta.es/club/instalaciones/ |publisher=RC Celta de Vigo |access-date=1 June 2024 |language=es}} | owner = | chairman = [[Marián Mouriño]] | chrtitle = President | manager = [[Claudio Giráldez]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Spanish football updater|Celta Vigo}} | season = {{Spanish football updater|Celta Vigo2}} | position = {{Spanish football updater|Celta Vigo3}} | pattern_la1 = _celta2627h | pattern_b1 = _celta2627h | pattern_ra1 = _celta2627h | pattern_sh1 = _celta2627h | pattern_so1 = _celta2627hl | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = | socks1 = | pattern_la2 = _celta2627a | pattern_b2 = _celta2627a | pattern_ra2 = _celta2627a | pattern_sh2 = _celta2627a | pattern_so2 = _celta2627al | leftarm2 = | body2 = | rightarm2 = | shorts2 = | socks2 = | pattern_la3 = _celta2627t | pattern_b3 = _celta2627t | pattern_ra3 = _celta2627t | pattern_sh3 = _celta2627t | pattern_so3 = _celta2627tl | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = D30430 | current = 2026–27 RC Celta de Vigo season | website = {{URL|https://rccelta.es/}} }} '''Real Club Celta de Vigo''' ({{IPA|gl|reˈal ˈkluβ ˈθeltɐ ðɪ ˈβiɣʊ}}; {{Literal translation|Royal Celtic Club of Vigo}}), commonly known as '''Celta Vigo''' or just '''Celta''', is a Spanish professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Vigo]], [[Galicia (Spain)|Galicia]], that competes in [[La Liga]], the top tier of [[Spanish football league system|Spanish football]]. Nicknamed ''Os Celestes'' (The Sky Blues), the club was founded in August 1923 as ''Club Celta'', following the merger of [[Real Vigo Sporting]] and [[Real Fortuna Football Club|Real Fortuna]]. The club's home stadium is [[Balaídos]], which seats 24,870 spectators. The club's name is derived from the [[Celts|Celtic peoples]] who once lived in Galicia. Celta have a long-standing rivalry with fellow Galician club [[Deportivo de La Coruña|Deportivo A Coruña]], with whom they contest the [[Galician derby]]. Celta have never won the league title nor [[Copa del Rey]], although they have reached the final three times in the latter. The club finished in their best-ever position of fourth in [[2002–03 La Liga|2002–03]], qualifying for the [[2003–04 UEFA Champions League]], where they were eliminated by [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] in the round of 16. In the [[2016–17 UEFA Europa League]], Celta reached the semi-finals for the first time, losing to [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]]. In [[2000 UEFA Intertoto Cup|2000]], Celta were one of the co-winners of the [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]]."}}
